Involvement

Act One

Booyahg Shekt is positioned in the main hall of the Shattered Sanctum, east of the throne.

Idle banter

Shekt will occassionally chat with  Tracker Azak

  • Booyahg Shekt
    You ever been to the Underdark?
  • Tracker Azak
    I was born in the Underdark, mate. An' I've got the lash-marks to show fer it.
  • Booyahg Shekt
    Poor bastard. Slave-stock, are ya?
  • Tracker Azak
    Yeah. An' the one thing I learned down there...
  • Tracker Azak
    ...don't matter if you're a slave or a king. Drow'll pluck out yer eyes if you look at 'em wrong.
